state.platform: Instagram franchise, short-form episodes 15-45s plus reels, scrolling strangers with zero context
state.owned_lanes_already: school horror (The Substitute), blacklight minigolf world (Glow Golf Chronicles), cursed found-footage reach posts
state.assets_available: AI image/video pipeline at 0-credit stills, character-bible workflow proven, Buffer scheduling live
state.facts: operator is a solo creator-director; strongest engagement grammar so far is analog evidence formats

criteria.magnitude: MAGNITUDE — every episode: one ordinary person, one glass barrier, one impossible body passing too close on the other side. Civilian phone footage grammar, one reflection clue, never explain.
criteria.nightshift_league: NIGHTSHIFT LEAGUE — after the mall closes, the vending machines, arcade cabinets and mini-mart knights clock in and fight for turf. Security-cam grammar, deadpan sports-commentary tone.
criteria.archive_of_rain: ARCHIVE OF RAIN — a coastal city where rain carries memories; a two-person team retrieves pasts from the water and catalogs them, and sometimes the wrong past gets delivered to the wrong person.
criteria.puppet_crime_desk: PUPPET CRIME DESK — 1988 regional public-access crime drama performed entirely by handmade tabletop puppets; noir cases, felt witnesses, evidence boards.
criteria.lost_toy_universe: THE LOST TOY UNIVERSE — a 1987 action-figure line killed three months before launch; the feed is its blister cards, catalogs and toy commercials from a universe that got cancelled.

dimensions.comprehension: Which franchise is easiest for a stranger to understand in 2 seconds, no explanation?

dimensions.episode_breadth: Which franchise generates the most distinct episode ideas before running dry?
dimensions.poster_sell: Which franchise is easiest to sell in one poster image?
dimensions.distinctness: Which franchise is most distinct from anything already big on Instagram?
